title: Exclude P112 TWOSIDE profile 2,3,6^5,7^4 via A3 shortening
body:
## Summary

Exclude the literal historical P112 TWOSIDE `(7,4)` profile `2,3,6^5,7^4` over every characteristic-zero field, conditional on the pinned PR3234 A3 theorem.

```text
11 independent pieces, code intersection >=7
  delete four unrestricted weight-seven pieces
7 independent pieces, code intersection >=3
  common small support <=26; four rank-six endpoints
PR3234 support 29 theorem gives intersection <=2
```

Only `research/p112-twoside-a3-application/` is added. The package contains the written implication, exact profile/source binding, application receipt and registered replay. The source theorem is retained for inspection and is not replayed here.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the profile survives the original PR3154 BK/BK7 filters; the older unrestricted support 22 bound does not cover its common support 26.
  **After:** all deletion, independence and support hypotheses bind to PR3234, yielding `3>2`. Two separate implementations agree over all 11,452 original-cell multisets and reproduce its 154 historical survivors. This does not count other 153 as unresolved.
- Registered standard-library CPython 3.12 replay and eight behavioral controls pass. Ruff, formatting, metadata/source pins and `git diff --check` pass. A read-only Git-free committed export passes under optimized CPython 3.15; all 17 publication-byte comparisons pass.
- Worker 2's internal read-only peer check found no blocker in the implication, ran the primary verifier and matched all six retained sources against pinned Git objects. The exact reviewed hashes and later nonmathematical changes are recorded. This is automated peer review, not human or formal verification.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-twoside-a3-application
```

Commit `ca678025223f6c957efacbcb1254109d3881b4ff`; baseline and prepublication canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003035).

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`, Nick Petalas/PR3234 at `bd90899d5a45806288f7f3c9f177172a0ef5fa59`, PR3221/3227, and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. The pending A3 theorem, finite root geometry and Weyl-chamber statement remain inherited dependencies. Full C5, the full decoder floor, supplier admission, kappa and selected-frontier changes are outside this claim. No Lean, Docker or full selected replay was run. Open next questions are explicit in README/TASK.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new research package. No shared verifier, frozen predecessor or selected-result change. Archival retention would not admit the pending source theorem or this application as a complete decoder proof.
